content: {"question":"What is the minimum number of direct reports a manager must have to receive an engagement survey result report?","answer":"Managers must have 5 or more direct reports who responded to the survey.","evidence":"After action items have been identified at the E-Group level, all managers who received an engagement survey result report (AKA: managers with 5+ direct reports who responded to the survey) will also be asked to create an action plan in Culture Amp."}
